summary: Verified new admin-side 'PING ANY EMPLOYEE' roster panel on Console (AdminDashboard) empty-state. Static checks: Bell import present (line 10), nudge useMutation posts to /sessions/nudge/{userId} (lines 51-59), employees useQuery on /employees (lines 63-66), empty-state renders data-testid='no-active-sessions' + per-employee 'roster-nudge-{id}' buttons (lines 138-170). Live UI test on preview URL: logged in as owner, /admin loaded with 0 active sessions → panel visible, 1 roster-nudge-* button rendered for Sample Employee, clicking it fired POST /api/sessions/nudge/{id} → 200, sonner toast 'Reminder sent to employee@example.com' displayed. Backend regression: pytest tests/test_admin_nudge.py -n 0 → 5/5 passed in 1.99s. Curl to preview: POST /api/sessions/nudge/{valid_employee_id} → 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Roster panel currently lists ALL employees in the org (including admin/owner). Consider filtering to role=='employee' only — otherwise the admin can nudge themselves. Non-blocking; nudge endpoint just sends a push and returns 200.
employees useQuery has no explicit staleTime — the panel will refetch on every window focus. Fine for small orgs; consider staleTime for larger deployments.

'PING ANY EMPLOYEE' panel is only shown in the empty state. Once the first active session appears the panel disappears, which may confuse admins who still want to nudge idle employees. Consider showing it as a collapsible secondary section always.
